event.firm_key: BOTTLING LLC DBA PEPSI BEVERAGES COMPANY
event.recalling_firm: Bottling LLC dba Pepsi Beverages Company

products.product_description: Diet Crush Orange Soda, 12 oz cans
products.reason_for_recall: Dr Pepper/Seven Up, Inc. has initiated a recall of mislabeled Diet Crush Orange Soda produced under license issued by one of their licensed bottlers, Pepsi Beverages Company in Phoenix, Arizona. The bottler used new graphics on cans of product made with the previous formulation which is in the process of being discontinued.
